title: Silent Crash of AAPS
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
Setup : 
- Phone One plus Nord with Android 11
- AAPS version : 2.8.2.19-dev (Build 0a1cbdb91)
- All battery optimization are deactivated
- BG from BYODA only in version 1.7.03


AAPS has crash silently. The first screenshot shows around 3pm30 (17 january 2021) that AAPS stops everything and the most problematic thing is that the pod doesn't fallback on my basal profile until I check my phone around 6pm. The second screenshot shows the pod history ans we can see a TBR set to 0u at 3pm24 precisely and another TBR set at 3.2u at 6pm14 when I check my phone. In this time frame, my bg has rised (Look at the last screenshot in red rectangle).

I also attach the AAPS logs just after the issue observed.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1642440166854.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7888178/AndroidAPS_LOG_1642440166854.log.zip)
